purpose: One pinned, 3D-rotating step panel. FOUR instances, each with its own gradient.

props.heading: heading.step, 3-4 words
props.infoTags: exactly 2 per slide, label.secondary, 2-4 words each
props.infoCopy: label.emphasis, split across an .u-indent first line and an .u-fonts-50-stb remainder

behaviour: public/motion/m29.js pins .list__main__slide instances with ScrollTrigger and rotates .list__main__content in 3D on power1.in. Slides 1-3 ship a Webflow .pin-spacer with baked inline geometry (1920x1872 with 936px bottom padding); the FOURTH slide has no .pin-spacer, so it is the resting slide. [data-flash-stb] on the heading and the step numeral hooks the m24 flash reveal.

responsive.base: pinned 3D stack with perspective 250vw on the content wrapper
responsive.max-767px: heading.step and heading.display both become 2.25rem, so the heading and the step numeral render at the same size

notes: CORRECTION TO THE BUILD GROUNDWORK: the step gradients were described as a three-variant set (.is-first / .is-second / .is-third). There are FOUR. .is-fourth exists in the stylesheet at fourmula-base.css:4037-4039 as linear-gradient(#9a0101, #fd7b03) and in the markup at ListSection.jsx:114. A fifth gradient, the shared .list__main__bottom-gradient scrim (#fc730300 -> #fc7303, 10rem tall) was also unrecorded. SEPARATELY, the malformed-CSS quirk lives here: src/styles/fourmula-head.css:150-159 keeps `transform-style: preserve-3d` and `transform-origin: 50% 10%` COMMENTED OUT because the original ships the first without a semicolon, so browsers discard both. DO NOT 'FIX' IT - doing so creates a visible divergence from the original.
